text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: alert: sustained error spike on variant redwood-llama-quant-eu-v3 — 5xx rate 8.1% over 3m, p95 latency 2.6s, QPS up 45%
ops-bot: auto-tags: region=eu, model=redwood-llama-quant-eu-v3, impact=production
mia: saw this start ~2123456720, looks correlated with heavy keys 'partner-eu' and some long prompts, also KV cache churn high
raj: paging oncall @sara — this one is causing customer errors, need mitigation ASAP :exclamation:
sara: oncall responding, joining now. can you dump the recent error traces and top keys?
mia: attaching quick aggregates (snippet):
```
Key         | 5xx / min | QPS
partner-eu  | 120       | 18
public-prod | 15        | 5
dev         | 2         | 0.6
```

leo: likely regression after quant kernel update this morning, but let's treat as live mitigation first
ops-bot: recommended mitigations: 1) remove variant from routing 2) apply emergency key-level throttle to heavy keys 3) fallback traffic to redwood-llama-stable-eu-v2 4) open post-incident with quant team
sara: agree. I'll remove variant from routing. command to run:
```
# disable variant in control plane and shift traffic
rlsctl variant disable --name redwood-llama-quant-eu-v3 --force --reason "emergency 5xx spike"
# sample curl if you need control-plane API
curl -s -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/variants/disable \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"variant":"redwood-llama-quant-eu-v3","force":true}'
```

sara: running disable now...
ops-bot: scheduling config push to edge routing in 10s
sara: disabled. control-plane response: `{"variant":"redwood-llama-quant-eu-v3","status":"disabled","drain_seconds":30}`
ops-bot: traffic reroute started — fallback target redwood-llama-stable-eu-v2, gradual cutover 100% over 30s
mia: applying emergency per-key QPS for partner-eu to 2 QPS to give runtime breathing room:
```
rlsctl quotas set --key partner-eu --qps 2 --reason "emergency mitigation"
```

raj: pushed quota change, CDN and edge caches invalidated for routing table.
leo: monitoring: within 90s after disable, 5xx down to 0.9%, p95 latency dropped to ~510ms. good.
sara: initial customer impact assessment:
- impacted keys: partner-eu (reduced throughput => increased tail-latency for some calls)
- direct customer reports: 2 partners reported slower responses, no data loss, no failed billing events
- user-visible errors: mostly 5xx from variant; after mitigation errors dropped to baseline

mia: cost note: fallback to stable increases token cost ~+12% for affected requests; OK for short-term mitigation
ops-bot: created incident ticket INC-2026-4317, severity=P2, mitigation actions logged and assigned to quant-team
sara: handing off to next oncall @leo for overnight watch. I will add playbook steps for rollback/reenable: check 5xx < 0.5% for 1h, run canary traffic 5% for 30m, then 20% for 1h.
leo: ack. I'll coordinate with quant infra tomorrow morning, and keep monitoring alerts on.
sara: leaving notes for postmortem: root-cause hypothesis: quantized kernel path regression under heavy KV churn; required deeper tracing and perf capture from quant infra team.
raj: +1 on PM to include prompt size distribution for partner-eu, and whether suffix-cache evictions correlated
sara: incident mitigated, closing active paging. please follow up in INC-2026-4317 and mark any customer comms with updates. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: incident marked mitigated by sara at 2123457169 — duration 7m40s — reason: variant disabled + key throttles + fallback routing
leo: :thumbsup: I'll open a quick RFC to add automated circuit-breaker when quant variance spikes >5% for 3m.
